title: Israel prepares for full West Bank closure

slides.headline: Israel prepares for full West Bank closure
slides.subtitle: Two soldiers were killed in a shooting near Hebron

slides.explanation: This order affects the entire West Bank, a territory home to roughly 3 million people. The closure would restrict movement across the region.

slides.headline: A major shift in regional movement policy
slides.explanation: Officials ordered the military to prepare for a total lockdown. This goes beyond standard security measures and signals a major escalation.
Six independent news organizations including the BBC, Al Jazeera, and the Guardian have verified these details. This consensus confirms the government order is official.

caption:
Israel has ordered its military to prepare for a complete closure of the West Bank.

This decision follows a shooting incident near Hebron that resulted in the deaths of two Israeli soldiers.

The directive marks a notable escalation in security protocols for the region. A full closure would severely restrict the movement of millions of residents living in the area.

We have verified these details across six different international outlets to ensure you get an accurate picture of the situation.
